terms: Zrzur is a volunteer project, and this is a volunteer role in it: unpaid, with no fixed hours and no duty to be available. You can step down at any time. It is not a job and not employment.
received.title: Your application arrived
received_volunteers.title: Your application arrived
interview.title: A short talk about your application
interview.body:
{reviewer} from the Zrzur Team will write to you in a private message about your application for “{role}”.

The team never asks for your password, a sign-in code, money or documents.

owner_manual.title: Accepted: a role only you can give
owner_manual.body: {reviewer} accepted {applicant} for “{role}”. Zrzur never gives this role by itself. If you agree, give it by hand.
role.support.name: Support
role.support.description: Answers people's questions and points them to the right place.
role.support.rules: Be kind and patient, answer only what you know, and pass on what you cannot solve. Never ask anyone for a password or a code. What you read in staff channels stays there.
role.moderator.name: Moderator
role.moderator.description: Keeps the server friendly and within the Community Guidelines.
role.moderator.rules: Act on the Community Guidelines, not on taste. Warn before you remove, write a reason for every action, and never moderate a dispute you are part of. What you read in staff channels and reports stays there.
role.discover-reviewer.name: Discover Reviewer
role.discover-reviewer.description: Reviews servers and bots that ask to be listed on Discover.
role.discover-reviewer.rules: Judge every request by the listing rules only, never review your own or a friend's server or bot, and write a clear reason when you reject. What you read in staff channels stays there.
role.community-manager.name: Community Manager
role.community-manager.description: Plans events and keeps the server active and welcoming.
role.community-manager.rules: Announce events early, keep them open to everyone, and never promise prizes or perks in Zrzur's name without the owner's word. What you read in staff channels stays there.
role.designer.name: Designer
role.designer.description: Makes artwork and designs for Zrzur and its community.
role.designer.rules: Share only designs that are your own or that you may use, and name the source of anything you did not make. Nothing is copied from other apps.
role.developer.name: Developer
role.developer.description: Helps build Zrzur, its bots and its developer documentation.
role.developer.rules: Contributions go through pull requests under the project's licence. Never share keys, tokens or other people's data, and report a security problem in private first.
role.administrator.name: Administrator
role.administrator.description: Helps run the official servers together with the owner.
role.administrator.rules: This role is given by the owner in person and can be taken back at any time. Use every power only for the task it was given for, and write down what you change. What you read in staff channels stays there.
question.experience.label: Your experience
question.experience.hint: What have you done that fits this role? Links are welcome.
question.why.label: Why do you want this role?
question.why.hint: A few honest lines are enough.
accepted_notice.title: You accepted an application
accepted_notice.body: You accepted {applicant} for “{role}”. If this is not what you meant to do, tell the owner of Zrzur at once.
about_too_young.title: We cannot take this further yet
about_too_young.body: Volunteers on the Zrzur Team are 16 or older. Nothing you typed was saved; the form itself is deleted within 15 minutes. Thank you for your interest.
about_bad_age.title: Please check your age
about_bad_age.body: Please type your age as a number between 16 and 99, for example 24. Nothing was saved; the form itself is deleted within 15 minutes.
about_rules.title: One tick is missing
about_rules.body: Please tick that you read and accept the volunteer rules. Nothing was saved; the form itself is deleted within 15 minutes.
identity_missing.title: Please tell us about you first
identity_missing.body: Before you apply, press “Apply” and fill in “About you” (name, age, country) and accept the volunteer rules. It takes a minute.
volunteer.invite.title: Your invite to the team server
volunteer.invite.body:
Thank you for volunteering as “{role}”. Here is your personal invite to the Zrzur Team server: https://zrzur.cc/{invite}

It works once and ends in 7 days. Please keep it to yourself.
volunteer.counting: Once you are a volunteer, we count how often you help each day in the official servers: messages and replies in your team's work channels, moderation actions, applications reviewed and messages in tickets. Counts only: never what you wrote or read. We use them to see who is still around and to send a friendly reminder. Only the owner sees your own numbers; the team server sees only weekly totals of teams of three or more. You see yours under “My team status”. Days kept: {days}. Nothing happens automatically because of them. You can object at any time: if you object, tell the owner and your counting stops. More: {privacy}
volunteer.counting_notice.title: How we look after the team
volunteer.counting_notice.body:
Thank you for being a volunteer in the Zrzur Team. Something we want you to know: from now on, we count how often you help each day in the official servers: messages and replies in your team's work channels, moderation actions, applications reviewed and messages in tickets. Counts only: never what you wrote or read. We use them to see who is still around and to send a friendly reminder. Only the owner sees your own numbers; the team server sees only weekly totals of teams of three or more. You see yours under “My team status”. Days kept: {days}. Nothing happens automatically because of them. You can object at any time: if you object, tell the owner and your counting stops. More: {privacy}

Nothing was counted before this message.
volunteer.identity_request.title: Please add your details
volunteer.left.title: Thank you
volunteer.left.body: Your volunteer role “{role}” has ended. Thank you for the time you gave to the Zrzur Team. You are welcome back whenever you like.
volunteer.removed.title: Your volunteer role has ended
volunteer.away.title: You are away
volunteer.away.body: Thank you for telling us. Days away: {days}. Nothing is expected of you meanwhile. When you are back, press “My team status”, then “I'm away”, and type 0.
volunteer.back.title: Welcome back
volunteer.back.body: Your volunteer role is active again. Thank you, and there is no hurry: help when you have time.
volunteer.reminder.title: We missed you
volunteer.reminder.body:
Thank you for being a volunteer in the Zrzur Team. Last month we saw little of your help, and that is completely fine: everyone has busy times.

Help when you have time; a little is enough. If you need a break, press “My team status” in the apply channel, then “I'm away”, and we will not ask again meanwhile.
volunteer.leave_confirm.text: Leave the Zrzur Team as “{role}” in {server}? Your role there ends now. Thank you for the time you gave; you are welcome back whenever you like.
volunteer.leave_confirm.label: Yes, leave
staff.trial_ended.title: Getting-to-know period ended
staff.trial_ended.body: The getting-to-know period of {account} as “{role}” has ended. Please confirm the volunteer or end the role on the Team page of the admin console.
